source_row.rationale: Acute compartment syndrome is a surgical emergency because rising compartment pressure can cause irreversible nerve and muscle ischemia. Urgent fasciotomy is the definitive decompressive treatment when indicated, making Option B correct. Observation, tighter compression, or massage can delay or worsen care.
source_row.source_detail: Treatment/Management: acute compartment syndrome is a surgical emergency; remove restrictive dressings/casts and obtain immediate surgical consultation; definitive treatment is urgent fasciotomy when indicated to prevent irreversible nerve and muscle ischemic injury. Current StatPearls/NCBI Bookshelf Acute Compartment Syndrome entry live-rechecked 2026-08-15.
